Package com.github.crittscott.somebuckets.gametest

Class GameTestSupport

java.lang.Object
com.github.crittscott.somebuckets.gametest.SharedGameTestSupport
com.github.crittscott.somebuckets.gametest.GameTestSupport
final class GameTestSupport extends SharedGameTestSupport
NeoForge counterpart of the Forge GameTestSupport. The vanilla and loader-neutral helpers come from SharedGameTestSupport; this class adds NeoForge item accessors, the common fluid-logic context entry points, and a NeoForge Capabilities.FluidHandler.BLOCK-backed sided tank fixture.

  • Field Details

    • TEMPLATE

      static final String TEMPLATE
      Bare structure name. The NeoForge GameTest registry prefixes this with the @GameTestHolder namespace (and, unless @PrefixGameTestTemplate(false) is present, the class name), so the effective template is somebuckets:empty_9x6x9.
